nodes.label: Voice Agent Example
nodes.rationale: Spring AI Alibaba voice agent demo implementing the Sandwich architecture for a sandwich shop assistant scenario

nodes.label: Sandwich Architecture (STT → Agent → TTS)
nodes.rationale: Three-component chained pipeline: Speech-to-Text, LLM Agent, Text-to-Speech — a Combined S2S approach

nodes.label: STT (Speech-to-Text)
nodes.rationale: First stage of the Sandwich pipeline: converts streaming audio input into text transcripts

nodes.label: ReactAgent (LLM Agent)
nodes.rationale: Middle stage of the Sandwich pipeline: receives transcript, calls tools, generates response text

nodes.label: TTS (Text-to-Speech)
nodes.rationale: Final stage of the Sandwich pipeline: converts agent text response into streaming audio output

nodes.label: DashScope (Alibaba Cloud AI Platform)
nodes.rationale: Alibaba Cloud AI platform providing ASR, TTS, and LLM capabilities; offers realtime streaming ASR and TTS

nodes.label: DashScope Realtime ASR
nodes.rationale: DashScope's realtime streaming speech recognition capability used for the STT stage

nodes.label: Paraformer Realtime V2
nodes.rationale: DashScope ASR model: paraformer-realtime-v2 with streamRecognition for realtime audio transcription

nodes.label: DashScope CosyVoice TTS
nodes.rationale: DashScope's streaming text-to-speech capability used for the TTS stage

nodes.label: CosyVoice V3 Flash
nodes.rationale: DashScope TTS model: cosyvoice-v3-flash with streaming text input for realtime speech synthesis

nodes.label: Qwen Series (LLM)
nodes.rationale: DashScope-hosted Qwen large language model series used as the reasoning engine for the ReactAgent

nodes.label: add_to_order(item, quantity)
nodes.rationale: Agent tool for adding sandwich ingredients to the current order by item name and quantity

nodes.label: confirm_order(order_summary)
nodes.rationale: Agent tool for finalizing and confirming the complete sandwich order with a summary

nodes.label: Sandwich Shop Ingredients
nodes.rationale: Available menu items: vegetables (lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles), condiments (mayo, mustard), meats (turkey, ham, roast beef), cheeses (swiss, cheddar, provolone)

nodes.label: WebSocket API
nodes.rationale: Primary communication protocol: WebSocket-only API with JSON event streaming for both modes

nodes.label: ws://localhost:8080/voice/ws/audio
nodes.rationale: Audio input WebSocket endpoint for realtime bidirectional streaming: PCM 16kHz 16-bit mono binary → STT → Agent → TTS stream

nodes.label: ws://localhost:8080/voice/ws
nodes.rationale: Text input WebSocket endpoint: JSON messages with full pipeline or TTS-only mode

nodes.label: Binary Audio Protocol (PCM 16kHz 16-bit mono)
nodes.rationale: Audio input format for the /voice/ws/audio endpoint: raw PCM samples at 16kHz sample rate, 16-bit depth, single channel

nodes.label: Text JSON WebSocket Protocol
nodes.rationale: JSON message format for /voice/ws endpoint: {text, ttsOnly} messages trigger full or TTS-only pipeline

nodes.label: stt_chunk Event
nodes.rationale: Server-sent event: partial STT transcript during realtime audio recognition, fields: transcript, ts

nodes.label: stt_output Event
nodes.rationale: Server-sent event: final STT result after speech recognition completes, fields: transcript, ts

nodes.label: agent_chunk Event
nodes.rationale: Server-sent event: streaming agent response text chunk, fields: text, ts

nodes.label: tool_call Event
nodes.rationale: Server-sent event: agent invokes a tool, fields: id, name, args, ts

nodes.label: tool_result Event
nodes.rationale: Server-sent event: tool execution result, fields: toolCallId, name, result, ts

nodes.label: agent_end Event
nodes.rationale: Server-sent event: agent has finished processing, fields: ts

nodes.label: tts_chunk Event
nodes.rationale: Server-sent event: synthesized audio chunk as base64-encoded data, fields: audio (base64), ts

nodes.label: error Event
nodes.rationale: Server-sent event: error message, fields: message

nodes.label: Web UI (localhost:8080)
nodes.rationale: Browser-based real-time voice interaction UI with voice mode (Start/End Session) and text mode

nodes.label: Voice Mode (UI)
nodes.rationale: UI interaction mode: click Start Session, speak into microphone, click End Session to process via realtime pipeline

nodes.label: Text Mode (UI)
nodes.rationale: UI interaction mode: type a message and press Enter or click Send for text-based pipeline processing

nodes.label: Native S2S (Speech-to-Speech)
nodes.rationale: Architecture pattern: single end-to-end model directly processes audio input to audio output without intermediate text; lower latency, better prosody/emotion preservation, fewer vendor options

nodes.label: Combined S2S (STT + LLM + TTS)
nodes.rationale: Architecture pattern: three chained components (STT, LLM Agent, TTS); higher flexibility with swappable components, slightly higher latency, TTS-quality dependent, more vendor options

nodes.label: OpenAI GPT-Realtime (Realtime API)
nodes.rationale: Vendor in Native S2S category: single model handling audio I/O, low latency, supports tool calling

nodes.label: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash + Gemini Live API
nodes.rationale: Vendor in Native S2S category: native audio I/O, 30+ HD voices, 24 languages
nodes.norm_label: google gemini 2.5 flash + gemini live api

nodes.label: ElevenLabs Conversational AI 2.0
nodes.rationale: Vendor in Native S2S category: end-to-end voice conversation, <100ms latency, 32+ languages

nodes.label: 阿里云 智能语音交互 (ISI)
nodes.rationale: Vendor in Combined S2S category: realtime ASR + Tongyi LLM + speech synthesis, requires manual chaining
nodes.norm_label: 阿里云 智能语音交互 (isi)

nodes.label: 科大讯飞 星火语音大模型
nodes.rationale: Vendor in Combined S2S category: ASR + speech synthesis, voice interaction platform
nodes.norm_label: 科大讯飞 星火语音大模型

nodes.label: 百度 SpeechT5
nodes.rationale: Vendor in Combined S2S category: unified speech model supporting ASR, TTS, and translation

nodes.label: 微软 Azure Speech + Copilot
nodes.rationale: Vendor in Combined S2S category: Azure Speech Services + conversational model, requires composition

nodes.label: TTS-Only Mode
nodes.rationale: Text WebSocket mode variant: bypasses the agent and only synthesizes speech; triggered by {text, ttsOnly: true}

nodes.label: End Message ({type: end})
nodes.rationale: Text JSON message sent on the audio WebSocket to signal end of audio input and trigger pipeline processing

nodes.label: Realtime Bidirectional Streaming Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Audio WebSocket mode: full-duplex streaming where binary audio flows in and JSON events (STT/agent/TTS) flow out in real time

nodes.label: Spring AI Alibaba
nodes.rationale: Java framework for AI application development, providing DashScope integration and ReactAgent support

nodes.label: AI_DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
nodes.rationale: Required environment variable for DashScope API authentication; configured as spring.ai.dashscope.api-key

nodes.label: JDK 17+
nodes.rationale: Prerequisite: Java Development Kit version 17 or higher required to build and run the application

nodes.label: ffmpeg
nodes.rationale: Known prerequisite/limitation: ffmpeg required for audio format conversion in the pipeline; not explicitly documented in README but implied by audio processing needs

nodes.label: voice-agent-example (Spring Application Config)
nodes.rationale: Spring Boot application configuration: spring.application.name=voice-agent-example with DashScope API key binding

nodes.label: streamRecognition (ASR Config)
nodes.rationale: Configuration comment indicating paraformer-realtime-v2 uses streamRecognition mode for ASR

nodes.label: stream with text input (TTS Config)
nodes.rationale: Configuration comment indicating cosyvoice-v3-flash uses streaming mode with text input for TTS
